propositions: Plan-review must evaluate whether each direct prerequisite plan remains consistent with the subject plan and its contracted outputs without injecting prerequisite material into general criteria requests or changing existing parent/child review behavior.

Focused prerequisite routing requires exactly one PlanRelationSnapshot preload containing readable direct depends_on or inverse blocks relations; the same canonical ID reached through both relation forms is evaluated once in stable lexicographic order.

Prerequisite coverage must capture every readable pinned canonical ID with exactly one closed-schema disposition (consistent, finding, or indeterminate with reason code), and missing, duplicate, parse-invalid, or schema-invalid output maps unresolved IDs to indeterminate/output-invalid.

Prerequisite-scoped findings use a canonical four-field length-prefixed UTF-8 structured identity encoding (version, text, criteria, prerequisite-id) hashed with SHA-256, while non-prerequisite findings retain the existing pipe-delimited encoding byte-for-byte.

General and focused verification index domains must be independently reshaped and decided without shifting each other; focused findings remain in a separate 0..P-1 domain and are verified only by the focused verifier receiving authoritative prerequisite plan blocks.

Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record forces top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict even when DET blockers remain visible in the blocking array, and reclassified non-DET blockers move to indeterminate with reason=prerequisite-coverage-indeterminate.
